retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast trapezoidal emblem featuring a stylized insectoid mascot and futuristic typography set against a grimy, industrial halftone background.
excludeWhen: minimalist clean vector art is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, bold trapezoidal graphic containing a bi-tonal insect head and heavy block lettering, characterized by thick red and black borders and a distressed, weathered surface texture reminiscent of a screen-printed patch on concrete.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry of the central mascot head within the trapezoidal frame
High contrast between the black graphic elements and the muted, textured background
Tiered hierarchy of typography placed below the central icon
Repetition of thick red outlines to define the primary shape
coreInvariants: Stylized insectoid/ant head with large mandibles and antennae
Tri-color palette of red, black, and white
Distressed halftone or 'dirty' paper texture overlay

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central trapezoid occupying 70% of the frame, centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The stylized ant head mascot in the upper half of the trapezoid.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow from the mascot head to the large acronym, ending at the full text at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The surrounding area is a light, mottled beige/grey texture that pushes the dark emblem forward.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black for the primary graphic shapes and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright red for outlines and secondary accents.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for highlights and small text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation red against low value black, set on a desaturated, mid-value textured background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extended geometric sans-serif with futuristic, tech-inspired cuts.
letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke width for the smaller text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'A' and 'E' are simplified into geometric blocks
The letter 'N' uses a diagonal slash that doesn't fully connect
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A large, heavy acronym paired with a smaller, wide-tracked version of the same geometric style for the full name.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, technical, mid-century modern/futuristic vibe.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a distressed, mottled beige and grey background with visible halftone dots and industrial grime. Center a large black trapezoid with thick red and white borders. Inside the top half, place a stylized, symmetrical black and white ant head with large mandibles.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom geometric, ultra-wide block lettering in black for the main acronym and white for the full name at the bottom, ensuring the text follows the horizontal alignment of the trapezoid base.

verificationChecks: Is the trapezoid shape clearly defined by red borders?
Does the mascot have a symmetrical, insectoid appearance?
Is the texture gritty and reminiscent of a printed patch?
Is the typography ultra-wide and futuristic?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the insect mascot mandibles
postGenerationChecks: Check for halftone pattern consistency across the image.
Ensure the red color is punchy but weathered.
Verify that the text is legible despite the wide expansion.
Confirm the mascot is centered and symmetrical.
recipe.reuseFormula: Trapezoidal Frame + Stylized Mascot + Extended Tech Typography + Industrial Halftone Texture = Nu-Metal Aesthetic
